title: Telemetry and Privacy Boundaries
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting telemetry and privacy boundaries to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Apply data minimization: derive the logging plan from a stated question rather than from technical capability
Distinguish direct identifiers, indirect identifiers, and pseudonymous keys, and explain how combinations enable re-identification
Set purpose limitation and a retention window that match the consent learners actually gave
Reject "collect now, decide later" requests and state the harm they create

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
